get.summary: Search for users
get.description:
![Status: USABLE](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-USABLE-brightgreen)

Search for users using various attributes. Wildcard search with % (or *) allowed and query string must be URL encoded.
As operator you can use "AND" or "OR" for filtering the search based on ANY or ALL attributes matched.
When at least 2 search attributes are provided, the operator is required.

- Phone numbers are stored in our system using the country prefix format containing the "+" sign. For example, for a RO number the search should be initiated with the "+40" prefix. Using a wildcard instead of the prefix will have the effect of searching phone numbers from all countries.
- At the moment, using multiple search attributes together with email_pending or wildcard search by email_pending are not supported.

get.summary: Get users for current Application or Get a User by ApplicationID and ExternalID
get.description:
![Status: USABLE](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-USABLE-brightgreen)

This endpoint supports two distinct use cases:

**Use Case 1: List users for current application**
- Query with pagination parameters (per_page, page, include_totals) and optional filters (email, 2step_enabled)
- Do NOT include application_id or external_id parameters
- Response format depends on include_totals parameter:
  - include_totals=true (default): Returns object with total_users, total_pages, and users array
  - include_totals=false: Returns direct array of users

**Use Case 2: Get single user by ApplicationID and ExternalID**
- Query with both application_id AND external_id parameters (both required)
- Do NOT include other parameters (per_page, page, include_totals, email, 2step_enabled)
- Returns single user object
- **Note:** This use case is kept only for backwards compatibility, from when only a single user could be linked to a distinct ApplicationID and ExternalID combination. It returns the user which was the first one linked to the application. If you want to retrieve all users linked to an ApplicationID and ExternalID combination, use the GET /v2.0/users endpoint instead.

200.description:
OK. Indicates success. The response format depends on which use case is being invoked:
- Use Case 1 with include_totals=true: Returns object with total_users, total_pages, and users array
- Use Case 1 with include_totals=false: Returns direct array of users
- Use Case 2: Returns single user object
![Test automation: DONE](https://img.shields.io/badge/Test%20automation-DONE-brightgreen)
